insight: Founders Roy Lee and Neel Shanmugam were suspended from Columbia in 2025 over Interview Coder, the cheating tool that became Cluely.
name: Cluely
tagline: Real-time AI meeting assistant — answers and notes during the call.
description: Cluely is a desktop and mobile assistant that listens to your meetings, interviews, and sales calls and surfaces real-time notes and answers as an on-screen overlay. It markets an 'undetectable' mode that hides the overlay from screen-sharing software so other participants can't see it. The startup launched in April 2025 and raised $15M from Andreessen Horowitz, repositioning from its viral 'cheat on everything' origins into a mainstream meeting assistant.
edge: Runs as an invisible desktop overlay that can stay hidden from screen-sharing software, rather than joining the call as a visible meeting bot.
pros: Works over any meeting or call app
iOS plus Mac and Windows apps

references.title: Cluely, a startup that helps 'cheat on everything,' raises $15M from a16z
